description:
Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology, data-driven decision-making, and making a real impact on road safety?

Join our innovative team and help power the next generation of smart automotive lighting systems.

As an Algorithm Developer Student, you’ll take part in developing innovative algorithms for advanced automotive technologies, working on real-world challenges that combine software engineering, problem-solving, and data-driven development. You will contribute to the design, implementation, testing, and optimization of algorithms that power cutting-edge driver assistance and autonomous driving systems, focusing on light source classification.

You’ll be collaborating closely with experienced algorithm developers to create scalable, high-performance solutions while gaining hands-on experience with state-of-the-art automotive technologies.

What your job will look like:
- Your job will include a combination of classic programming and algorithm development.

- You will develop in both C++ and Python.

- You will need to both maintain the product and develop new features.

- Finally, you will need to learn and develop new algorithms that can address new problems as they arise.

All you need is:
- Studies towards a B.Sc/M.sc in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

- Availability for at least a 60% position.

- 2-3 semesters left until graduation.

- Hands-on programming experience in C++ and Python.

- Machine learning courses or background - an advantage.

Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!
title: Algorithm Developer Student

description:
Mobileye is looking for an Algorithm Developer Student to join our Calibration Team, part of the Geometry Group within the Algorithms R&D department. We are looking for excellent CS students, with strong problem-solving abilities, who are proactive, energetic, hard working and with a can-do attitude to help us solve hard problems and deliver world class calibration solutions.

We develop cutting-edge computational geometry products for Mobileye systems, essential for understanding vehicle surroundings and advancing AV (Autonomous Vehicles) and ADAS (Advanced Driving Assistance Systems).

Our work combines computational geometry, mathematics, physics, software engineering, and modern AI-assisted development methodologies to deliver high-performance, real-time solutions. While our algorithms are primarily based on classical geometric and optical principles, we also leverage Machine Learning techniques to further enhance calibration accuracy.

We are passionate about building clean, reliable, and maintainable software, creating internal development tools, and continuously improving engineering productivity.

What will your job look like:
- Implement, deploy, and maintain algorithms in computational geometry and calibration domains.

- Develop, maintain, and improve software infrastructure and internal tools supporting algorithm development and validation.

- Develop high-quality code primarily in C++ and Python.

- Design and maintain real-time oriented code that meets stringent memory and runtime requirements.

- Utilize modern AI-assisted development tools and frameworks (such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and similar technologies) to improve development efficiency and code quality.

- Collaborate effectively with other teams at Mobileye.

All you need is:
- Studies towards a B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, preferably combined with a minor in Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Biology, or a related scientific discipline.

- Availability for at least a 3 days a week.

- 2-3 semesters left until graduation.

- Hands-on programming experience in C++ and Python.

- Basic understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts.

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with Git and GitLab, backed by practical experience.

- Coursework, projects, or practical experience in Machine Learning and Deep Learning.

- Experience with AI-assisted development environments and coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms).

Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!
title: Algorithm SW Developer Student - Calibration Team

מחפשים/ות תפקיד טכנולוגי מגוון שמשלב תשתיות, מערכות, HPC ועבודה בסביבת מחקר מתקדמת?
לבית הספר באוניברסיטת בן-גוריון בנגב דרוש/ה אחראי/ת מערכות מחשוב ותשתיות IT, לתפקיד רחב הכולל אחריות על מערך המחשוב התומך בהוראה ובמחקר, עבודה עם תשתיות ושרתים, פתרון אתגרים טכנולוגיים והובלת פתרונות חדשים.
מה כולל התפקיד?
• אחריות על תפעול ותחזוקת מערכות המחשוב, החומרה, התוכנה, הרשת וחדרי השרתים.
• עבודה עם סביבות Windows, Unix, VMware ותשתיות GPU/HPC.
• אחריות על תקינות מערכות וציוד המחשוב במעבדות הוראה ומחקר ובסביבת העבודה של הסגל והסטודנטים.
• התקנות, עדכונים, טיפול בתקלות ומתן פתרונות לצורכי מחשוב מגוונים.
• אחריות על אבטחה וגיבוי של המערכות ועל התקנה ועדכון של מערכות הפעלה ותוכנות.
• הובלה מקצועית של הצוות הטכני ביחידת המחשוב, הגדרת משימות ומעקב אחר ביצוען.
• עבודה עם חברי הסגל האקדמי לאפיון צורכי מחשוב להוראה ולמחקר.
• סיוע בתכנון תקציב המחשוב, הגדרת תוכנות נדרשות וליווי תהליכי רכש של ציוד ומערכות.
• ייזום ויישום שינויים טכנולוגיים ופיתוח פתרונות לשיפור וייעול מערך המחשוב.
• מתן שירות, ייעוץ והדרכה לסטודנטים ולחברי הסגל.

דרישות:
• תואר ראשון במדעי המחשב, הנדסת תוכנה או הנדסת מערכות מידע – חובה; תואר שני – יתרון.
• לפחות 5 שנות ניסיון בתחומים רלוונטיים – חובה.
• ניסיון במתן שירות ותמיכת מחשוב למשתמשים.
• ניסיון בעבודה עם שרתי Unix, Windows, VMware וסביבות GPU/HPC.
• ניסיון בניהול בסיסי נתונים.
• ניסיון בהובלת צוות – יתרון.
• ניסיון בפיתוח ובתכנות מערכות מחשוב – יתרון.
• ניסיון בתחזוקה ובניהול צבירי מחשוב עתירי ביצועים (HPC) – יתרון.
אם אתם/ן אנשי/נשות תשתיות שאוהבים/ות גם לפתור בעיות וגם לחשוב קדימה, ורוצים/ות לעבוד בסביבה שבה הטכנולוגיה מאפשרת מחקר והוראה מתקדמים – נשמח להכיר.

היקף: משרה מלאה
ניסיון (לפי האתר): 3-4 שנים

About this role

At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits.

Always.

We’re ambitious.

We’re game changers.

And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them.

And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. So, what’s the role all about? As an Associate Software Engineer, you will join the team building NICE’s next-generation Workforce Management platform: a cloud-native system with

AI built in, used by some of the world’s largest enterprises to schedule tens of thousands of agents. In this role, you will build full-stack features alongside experienced engineers, use AI agents as your default way of working, and see your code reach production and real customers early on. You’ll work in a fast-paced, AI-driven environment with close mentoring.

From day one, we expect you to think a problem through before you code, ask good questions, and own the tasks you take on. If you’re curious, careful about detail, already building things with AI, and want to grow quickly into an engineer who owns features from start to finish, this role is tailor-made for you.

How will you make an impact?

Develop cloud features on AWS end to end with guidance from senior engineers, from understanding the requirement through tests to production.

Use AI agents in your everyday engineering work, and help improve the skills and practices the team relies on. Investigate bugs and performance issues down to the root cause, and support your fixes with evidence.

Write tests and test plans that catch edge cases before customers do. Grow quickly: take feedback from code reviews, share what you learn, and take on more ownership each release.

Have you got what it takes?

Computer Science B.Sc./BE/BEng (graduates, or students in their final year) GPA of at least 85 0–1 years of experience (internships, student positions and substantial projects count) Hands-on use of AI coding tools (agents, prompts, skills) in personal, academic or work projects

Strong grasp of OOP and OOD concepts, with sound algorithmic thinking

Basic knowledge of client/server software systems Thorough and structured: you break problems down, test your own work and don’t stop at “it works on my machine” Self-motivated and accountable, a quick learner and a team player

Good interpersonal communication skills Fluent English You will have an advantage if you also have:

Built an AI/LLM project, agent or tool, especially one other people used A final project, hackathon or open-source contribution you can walk us through in depth Experience in working with cloud (SAAS) environments

Leadership skills: you’ve driven an initiative, mentored others or improved how a team/process works What’s in it for you? Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr! Enjoy NiCE-FLEX! At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week.

Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

Requisition ID: 12019 Reporting into:

Group Lead, Engineering, CXone Role Type: Student About NiCE NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety.

Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

title: System Integration Student, SPIV team

description:
Annapurna Labs is a fabless semiconductor company founded by industry veterans. We develop leading-edge products on state-of-the-art process technologies, and we're looking for talented engineers to help us build a semiconductor platform based on a revolutionary architecture.

You'll help develop state-of-the-art products within a disruptive system architecture, working on the technologies that power the world's largest cloud provider in a dynamic, open and fast-paced environment. AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries.

You'll join the SoC Power Analysis team on the Graviton and Nitro product line. The team owns the full process of Power Analysis from architecture stages till post Si, including Arch definition and Si configuration of Power Management features.. We work closely with product definition, pre- and post-silicon validation, physical design, software and other teams across the full chip development cycle, from idea to mass production. Your work will impact the efficiency of chips in AWS data centers worldwide, and hence will have large-scale impact.

At Annapurna Labs, you'll play a key role in developing the next generation of semiconductor platforms for the world's largest cloud infrastructure, and in shaping the future of cloud computing.

Watch these videos to learn more about Annapurna Labs and the Graviton project:

AWS re:Invent 2025 - Keynote with Peter DeSantis and Dave Brown: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeUpUK0nhC0

AWS re:Invent 2025 - AWS Graviton: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=haSHl2BLhm8

Key job responsibilities

Analyze SoC Power consumption at Pre and Post Si stages

Contribute to SoC Power optimization during all stages of Design Cycle

Work with variety of teams to impact the quality of SoC power efficiency: Logic & Physical Design, PDN, Post-Si.

Optimize Power Team analysis processes to raise effectiveness of our work.

Solve challenging problems on a daily basis.

A day in the life

Work on state-of-the-art processor technology

Engage in the complete chip development cycle, from initial architecture through post-silicon analysis

Solve complex, multidisciplinary challenges

Collaborate with talented teams across the organization

Contribute directly to next-generation cloud computing solutions

Basic qualifications
- BSc in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering

- Strong problem solving skills

- Ability to handle multidisciplinary tasks that require knowledge in different chip design domains, and to work in a rapidly changing environment.

Preferred qualifications
- Previous experience (including academic projects or internships) in the following domains: Power analysis and optimization, Logic design, Backend design, Chip Verification.

- Familiarity with power analysis tools such as PrimeTime/PrimePower, PowerArtist, or Voltus

- Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: C, Python, Tcl.

- Strong communication skills and ability to effectively communicate and cooperate with other teams to complete tasks.
